subject: IgniteFest mentor pool — trial credit request / authorization
messages:
From: Sasha Reynolds <sasha@ignitefest.org>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: mentor trial credits for IgniteFest 2026

Hi Monica & Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick responses while we were planning the mentor track. IgniteFest runs Oct 3–5, and we expect a mentor pool of ~20 volunteers who will provide 1:1 support in the hands-on labs and office hours. Historically these mentors run lightweight experiments (few-shot prompts, embeddings for indexing demo data). For 2026 we want to offer each mentor a small sandbox credit allowance so they can demo Redwood-powered features to attendees.

Ask: would Redwood be able to provide a trial extension or promo credits (approx. 2,000 compute credits) that we can distribute to the 20 mentors? We also want a single-use promo code for attendees to try demos post-event.

Attached: ignitefest-mentor-roster.csv (names & roles).

Timeline: we need the promo code and any short promotional copy by Sep 18 so we can include it in the mentor welcome packet.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Sasha Reynolds
Community Lead, IgniteFest
Sasha@ignitefest.org

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: mentor trial credits for IgniteFest 2026

Forwarding Sasha's note — quick thoughts:

- This is aligned with our community grant playbook.
- 2,000 credits (total) is reasonable for a small mentor pilot, or we can do 100 credits each capped to 20 mentors.
- Need sign-off on marketing mention and a simple T&C (60-day expiration).

@Karthik — can you confirm that we have the promotional budget authority for this (monthly community allowance) and whether we should attach the standard credits-terms PDF?

Vanessa
Sr. Community Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: mentor trial credits for IgniteFest 2026

Thanks for the context. Approve in principle — small program like this is exactly the kind of engagement we want. A couple of quick asks before we issue credits:

1) Expected token / compute burn estimate (ballpark) per mentor so we can record cost to the community budget. If they run demos that include embeddings + generation, estimate ~1–2M tokens total across the cohort?
2) Promo mechanics: single-use code vs. tiered codes per mentor. Single-use that expires 60 days is easier to track.
3) Brand mention: we prefer a small "Powered by Redwood Inference" line in the mentor materials and an optional logo on the sponsor page.

If those conditions look OK we can issue:
- 2,000 credits total as a single promo code (single-use for the organizer to distribute)
- Trial extension option (an additional 30 days for the organizer account) if they need more time to consume credits

Please attach credits-terms-ignitefest.pdf (legal language). Monica — if you want me to sign off on the HubSpot record I can.

Karthik
Head of Growth Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mentor trial credits for IgniteFest 2026

Sasha — thanks for the details and the roster. Apologies for the brief back-and-forth; we wanted to confirm budget and mechanics.

We can support IgniteFest with the following: 
- A single promo code that redeems 2,000 community credits to be distributed to mentors/organizers.
- A 60-day expiration on the promo code from activation.
- A 30-day trial extension on the organizer account if you need extra time to consume credits.
- Small courtesy: we ask for an attribution line in the mentor welcome materials: "Labs powered by Redwood Inference" and a logo link to the IgniteFest sponsor page.

Promo details (attached as promo-ignitefest-2026.txt):
- CODE: IGNITE-REDWOOD-2026-XXXX (single-use, one-time redemption)
- Value: 2000 community credits
- Expires: 60 days after redemption
- Legal: see attached credits-terms-ignitefest.pdf

Please confirm acceptance of these terms by reply and we will issue the code and push the HubSpot record (HS-94832) live.
